**Finding: deviation (high, commercial) — § 2.1, ¶ p0012**

- **Issue:** The USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" is a Customer-payable liquidated amount for Services we never consume — the very penalty the playbook bars. It also contradicts § 7.1 (no minimum-use charge) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment).
- **Elsewhere checked and clean:** § 7.3 (no interest on disputed amounts), § 27.3 (termination "without penalty"), § 9/§ 10 (no early-termination fee), § 22.2 shortfall is a true-up for actual under-licensing, not an LD.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** replaces § 2.1 with an express no minimum-purchase / no shortfall or penalty provision, preserving our reduction and termination rights; fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees offered in the comment.
